approaches_tried.reason: git log on the FILE only shows when its content was last edited, not when it went stale relative to a live regeneration. Verified with disposable `git worktree`s at four commits (0ca3da46d, dc55aea6e, 6c767cd86, 6db20b5a0): INV passes clean through 0ca3da46d (this task's own plan-creation commit, no Lean files touched) and first fails at 6db20b5a0 (this dispatch's own Phase 1 commit). The staleness is caused by this task's own line additions to Incompleteness.lean and Skeleton.lean shifting the two READMEs' generated line-count tables -- not a pre-existing defect.

deviations.reason: The script FAILED on first run (INV check, 2 stale generated-inventory blocks). Root-caused to this task's own edits via git-worktree investigation (see approaches_tried), not a pre-existing defect. Fixed with `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` (regenerating FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md and root README.md -- a pure line-count update, 2 lines changed), confirmed with --check, then the full script re-run reports ALL CHECKS PASSED.
